questions.question: In a relational database, what is a primary key?

options.A: A key used to uniquely identify each record in a table
options.B: A key used to establish relationships between tables
options.C: A key used to sort records in a table
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A primary key uniquely identifies each record (row) in a table and cannot be NULL. Relationships between tables are established by foreign keys.

questions.question: Which HTTP method is used for retrieving data from a server?

options.D: DELETE

questions.explanation: GET requests retrieve data from a server. POST submits data, PUT replaces a resource and DELETE removes it.

questions.question: What is a NoSQL database?

options.A: A NoSQL database is a database that does not use the relational model.
options.B: A NoSQL database is a database that is not managed by a DBMS.
options.C: A NoSQL database is a database that is not stored on a physical device.
options.D: All of the above.

questions.explanation: NoSQL databases (document, key-value, column, graph) store data without the relational table model. They are still managed by a DBMS and stored on physical devices.

questions.question: Which one of the following techniques is not used in the binary tree?

options.D: None of the above

questions.explanation: Preorder, inorder and postorder are all standard binary tree traversal techniques, so none of them is 'not used'.

questions.question: Which of the following views is the best view to use when setting transition effects for all slides in a presentation?

options.D: Slide sorter view

questions.explanation: Slide Sorter view shows all slides as thumbnails, making it the best view to apply transitions to all slides.

questions.question: Which of the following is userdefined header file extension used in C++?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: User-defined header files in C++ are conventionally saved with the .h extension and included with #include "file.h". The .cpp extension is used for source files.

questions.question: Which one of the following is not the application of the queue data structure?

options.B: Resource is shared between various systems
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Balancing of symbols (parentheses matching) is done with a stack. Asynchronous data transfer and resource sharing among systems are queue applications.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a Web Service?

options.D: Using a banking portal for online transaction

questions.explanation: File transfer over Bluetooth is a local wireless transfer and does not use the Web. Online learning portals, e-mail and banking portals are delivered over the Internet.

questions.question: Which of the following is a top-down approach in which the entity's higher level can be divided into two lower sub-entities?

options.D: All of the above

questions.explanation: Specialization is a top-down process that divides a higher-level entity into lower-level sub-entities. Generalization is the bottom-up reverse, and aggregation treats a relationship as an entity.

questions.question: What is the purpose of HTML in a web application?

options.A: To define the structure of web pages
options.C: To add interactivity to web pages
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: HTML defines the structure and content of web pages. Styling is done with CSS and interactivity with JavaScript.

questions.question: Which layer of the TCP/IP stack corresponds to the OSI model transport layer?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: The host-to-host (transport) layer of the TCP/IP model corresponds to the OSI transport layer. The Internet layer corresponds to the OSI network layer.

questions.question: What is the role of the MISO pin in the RFID Module?

options.D: Manage Input Slave Op

questions.explanation: The RFID module (e.g. RC522) uses SPI, where MISO means Master In Slave Out, the line carrying data from the module to the controller. The other expansions are invented.

questions.question: A web server is ________.

options.C: A protocol used for secure communication
options.D: A computer that stores and delivers web pages

questions.explanation: A web server is a computer (with server software) that stores web pages and delivers them to clients over HTTP. A browser is the client that requests them.

questions.question: The private key in asymmetric key cryptography is kept by

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: In asymmetric encryption the sender encrypts with the receiver's public key, and only the receiver holds the matching private key to decrypt.

questions.question: What is the access specifier used to make members of a class accessible only within the same package?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: When no access modifier is given in Java, members get default (package-private) access and are visible only within the same package. private restricts access to the class itself.

questions.question: The dining philosophers problem is an example of a synchronization problem related to:

options.D: Interrupt handling

questions.explanation: The dining philosophers must share forks so that no two neighbours use the same fork at once, which is a classic mutual exclusion (and deadlock) problem. It is not about CPU scheduling or memory allocation.

questions.question: The protocol that is used to send e-mails is:

options.D: FTP

questions.explanation: SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol) sends/forwards e-mail. POP is used to retrieve mail from a server.

questions.question: Which symbol is used to define the start and end of XML tags?
questions.explanation: XML tags are enclosed in angle brackets < >, e.g. <book> and </book>.

questions.question: Which of the following is true for the language { a^p | p is a prime }?

options.A: It is regular but not context-free
options.B: It is neither regular nor context-free, but accepted by a Turing machine
options.C: It is not accepted by a Turing Machine
options.D: It is context-free but not regular

questions.explanation: By the pumping lemmas, {a^p | p is prime} is neither regular nor context-free, but primality can be checked by an algorithm, so a Turing machine decides (accepts) it. It is therefore recursive, not outside TM power.

questions.question: Which data structure is the best for implementing a priority queue?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A binary heap supports insert and delete-max/min in O(log n), making it the best choice. Arrays and linked lists need O(n) for one of these operations.

questions.question: Which software life cycle model is based on iterative prototyping?

options.D: Prototype model

questions.explanation: The spiral model combines the iterative nature of prototyping with the systematic steps of the waterfall model, repeating loops that each include risk analysis and prototyping. The waterfall model is strictly linear.

questions.question: A large computer information system maintains many different computer files. Which amongst them is called a perpetual file?

options.D: Update File

questions.explanation: A master file holds the relatively permanent (perpetual) core data of a system, such as customer or employee records, and is updated by transaction/update files.

questions.question: Which of the following is a valid SQL command

options.D: select

questions.explanation: SELECT is an SQL command used to query data. cin and cout are C++ stream objects and tuple is a relational term for a row.

questions.question: Full form of MQTT is

options.D: Message Queue Telemetry Transport

questions.explanation: MQTT stands for Message Queuing Telemetry Transport, a lightweight publish-subscribe protocol for IoT. The other expansions end incorrectly in 'Things'.

questions.question: In Excess-3 Code, why is the code considered self-complementing?

options.A: Because it can be converted to ASCII directly
options.B: Because the 9's complement of each digit can be obtained by inverting its bits
options.C: Because it is used for financial calculations
options.D: Because it is a form of Gray code

questions.explanation: In Excess-3, inverting all bits of a digit's code gives the code of its 9's complement (e.g. 2 = 0101, inverted 1010 = 7). It is not a Gray code and is unrelated to ASCII.
